title: Coded Clifford Measurements for Multiqubit Magic-State Cultivation
summary: Magic-state cultivation suppresses errors by measuring logical Clifford checks and discarding inconsistent outcomes. For an entangled resource, several measurement branches are usable, so their outcomes form a multibit classical record whose corruption can produce a logical-frame error. We show that this measurement record can be protected as a binary linear code. For any third-level Clifford-hierarchy unitary $U\in\mathcal C_3$, every parity of the branch bits can be measured by a commuting Hermitian Clifford check $C(v)=UX(v)U^\dagger$.
